verses.text: “When Israel dey child, den I love am, and call my son out of Egypt.
Di more dem call dem, di more dem go from dem. Dem sacrifice to di Baals, and burn incense to engraved images.
Yet na me teach Ephraim to waka. I take dem by dem arms, but dem no know say I heal dem.
I draw dem with cords of kindness, with bands of love. I be to dem like dem wey lift di yoke on dem jaws, and I bend down to dem and feed dem.
Dem no go return into di land of Egypt? But Assyria go be dem king, because dem refuse to return to me.
Di sword go fall on dem cities, and go consume dem bars, and devour dem, because of dem own counsels.
My people dey bent on turning away from me. Though dem call to di Most High, none at all go exalt am.
How I go give you up, Ephraim? How I go hand you over, Israel? How I go make you like Admah? How I go treat you like Zeboiim? My heart dey changed inside me. My compassion dey stirred together.
I no go execute di fierceness of my anger. I no go return to destroy Ephraim again, because I be God, and no man, di Holy One for your middle. I no go come in wrath.
Dem go waka after di Lord, wey go roar like lion. Yes, e go roar, and di children go come trembling from di west.
Dem go come trembling like bird out of Egypt, and like dove out of di land of Assyria. I go settle dem for dem houses,” talk di Lord.
Ephraim surround me with lies, and di house of Israel with deceit. Judah still dey unruly against God, even against di faithful Holy One.
Ephraim feed on wind, and chase after di east wind. E daily multiply lies and desolation. Dem make covenant with Assyria, and oil dey carried into Egypt.
Di Lord also get controversy with Judah, and go punish Jacob according to im ways. According to im deeds e go repay am.
For di womb e take im brother by di heel, and by im strength e contend with God.
Yes, e contend with di angel, and prevail. E weep, and make supplication to am. E find am for Bethel, and dere e speak with us,
even di Lord, di God of Armies, di Lord na im memorial name.
Therefore turn to your God. Keep kindness and justice, and wait continually for your God.
Di merchant dey, di balances of deceit dey for im hand. E love to oppress.
Ephraim talk, “Surely I don become rich. I don find wealth for myself. For all my labours dem no go find for me any iniquity wey be sin.”
But I don be di Lord your God from di land of Egypt. I go yet make you dwell for tents, as for di days of di solemn feast.
I don also speak to di prophets, and I don multiply visions, and by di ministry of di prophets I use parables.
If Gilead dey wicked, surely dem na vanity. For Gilgal dem sacrifice bulls. Yes, dem altars dey like heaps for di furrows of di field.
Jacob flee into di field of Aram. Israel serve for wife, and for wife e keep sheep.
By prophet di Lord bring Israel up out of Egypt, and by prophet e dey kept.
Ephraim don provoke to anger most bitterly. Therefore im Lord go leave im blood guilt on am, and go repay im reproach to am.
When Ephraim speak, trembling dey. E exalt imself for Israel. But when e become guilty through Baal, e die.

Now dem sin more and more, and don make molten images for demselves of dem silver, idols according to dem own understanding, all of dem di work of di craftsmen. Dem talk about dem, “Make di men wey sacrifice kiss di calves.”
Therefore dem go be like di morning cloud, and like di dew wey go early, like chaff wey dey driven with whirlwind out of di threshing floor, and like smoke out of di chimney.
Yet I don be di Lord your God from di land of Egypt. You no go know any god but me, and beside me no savior dey.
I know you for di wilderness, for di land of great drought.
According to dem pasture, so dem dey filled. Dem dey filled, and dem heart dey exalted. Therefore dem don forget me.
Therefore I dey to dem like lion. Like leopard I go lurk by di path.
I go meet dem like bear wey dem don rob of her cubs, and I go tear open di covering of dem heart. Dere I go devour dem like lion. Di wild animal go tear dem.
Israel, you don destroy yourself, but for me, for your help.
Where your king dey, so that e go save you for all your cities? And your judges, of whom you talk, “Give me king and princes”?
I give you king for my anger, and I take am away for my wrath.
Di iniquity of Ephraim dey bound up. Im sin dey stored up.
Di sorrows of woman wey dey travail go come on am. E na unwise son, because e no dey at di moment of birth wey e suppose come out of di womb.
I go ransom dem from di power of Sheol. I go redeem dem from death. Death, where your plagues dey? Sheol, where your destruction dey? Compassion go dey hidden from my eyes.

Though e dey fruitful among im brothers, east wind go come, di breath of di Lord coming up from di wilderness. Im spring go dey dried up, and im fountain go dey dry. E go plunder di storehouse of all pleasant treasures.
Samaria go bear her guilt, because she don rebel against her God. Dem go fall by di sword. Dem infants go dey dashed in pieces, and dem pregnant women go dey ripped open.
Israel, return to di Lord your God, because you don fall because of your iniquity.
Take words with you, and return to di Lord. Talk to am, “Take away all iniquity, and accept wetin dey good, so that we go offer di fruit of our lips.
Assyria no go save us. We no go ride on horses, neither we go talk any more to di work of our hands, ‘Una na our gods,’ because for you di fatherless dey find mercy.”
“I go heal dem of dem backsliding. I go love dem freely, because my anger don turn away from am.
I go be like di dew to Israel. E go blossom like di lily, and lengthen im roots like Lebanon.
Im branches go spread, and im beauty go be like di olive tree, and im fragrance like Lebanon.
Dem wey dwell under im shadow go return. Dem go flourish like di grain, and blossom like di vine. Im fame go be like di wine of Lebanon.
Ephraim go talk, ‘Wetin I get to do any more with idols?’ I go answer, and look after am. I be like green cypress tree. From me your fruit dey found.”
Who dey wise, make e understand dis things. Who dey prudent, make e know dem. Because di ways of di Lord dey right, and di righteous go waka for dem, but di rebellious go stumble inside dem.
